entities.summary: Ole Peter Hansen Balling was a Norwegian artist. Balling is most commonly associated with his portraits, several of which are featured in the National Portrait Gallery in Washington, D.C. Hansen 'Ole Peter' Balling was a painters & sculptors from Christiania (1823-04-13, Christiania–1906-05-01). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
